primaryQuery: do I still need Homebridge with Home Assistant

selectedBecause: The question recurs across r/homeassistant, Home Assistant Community, and a current GitHub discussion, while Google results mostly offer broad platform comparisons instead of a homeowner-safe keep-or-retire decision. Homebridge 2's active 2026 Matter work also makes older comparisons incomplete. Search Console's current high-impression opportunities were reviewed, but each close opportunity already has an ownerPath and therefore belongs in the refresh queue. searchReview.query: do I still need Homebridge with Home Assistant
searchReview.intent: Decide whether Home Assistant can replace an existing Homebridge installation while Apple Home and Siri remain usable, then migrate without duplicates or a household outage.
searchReview.resultGap: Current results explain that Home Assistant is a broader platform, but they rarely separate HomeKit Device, HomeKit Bridge, native integrations, Matter multi-admin, and the remaining plugin-specific reasons to keep Homebridge. They also omit a reversible sequence that backs up Homebridge, moves one device family at a time, avoids exposing the same accessory twice, and verifies Apple scenes and voice control before shutdown.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant HomeKit Bridge documentation
officialSources.supports: Home Assistant can expose selected supported entities to Apple Home and Siri, with filters and special accessory-mode requirements for cameras, locks, and televisions.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant HomeKit Device documentation
officialSources.supports: HomeKit accessories can pair directly to Home Assistant and then be exported back to Apple Home, but a HomeKit accessory can be paired with only one controller at a time.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant Matter documentation
officialSources.supports: A Matter device can be shared among controller fabrics, while a native integration may retain more product-specific features than the generic Matter path.

officialSources.name: Homebridge official repository and Matter documentation
officialSources.supports: Homebridge is a community plugin bridge for third-party device APIs; version 2 adds optional uncertified Matter bridging and does not make every plugin a Matter plugin.

officialSources.name: Homebridge current releases
officialSources.supports: Homebridge 2 is under active development in August 2026, so older comparisons that predate its Matter work are incomplete.

officialSources.name: Homebridge Backup and Restore documentation
officialSources.supports: A Homebridge backup contains configuration, cached accessories, pairing data, plugin information, and UI accounts, which provides a rollback point before migration.

existingCoverage.decision: The closest Tara article defines HomeKit Device and HomeKit Bridge and helps readers choose traffic direction; it does not answer whether an existing Homebridge server can be retired, identify plugin-only exceptions, or give a staged cutover and rollback plan. The new page will own that keep-versus-retire migration decision, link to the terminology guide for deeper setup details, and avoid re-explaining Apple camera recording or generic Matter multi-admin topics.
